ai.seo_question: Who are the 'them' referred to in the verse 'We gave them the explicit Book'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to Moses and Aaron, or more broadly to the Prophet Muhammad and his cousin Ali ibn Abi Talib, emphasizing the clarity of the divine law. The term 'al-Kitab al-Mustabin' underscores the unambiguous nature of the revelation, serving as a definitive guide that distinguishes truth from falsehood. This highlights the Shia belief in the continuity and clarity of divine guidance through chosen prophets and their successors.
